title: State of Punjab v. Harpreet Singh
charge: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons under Section 117(2) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023

truth.motive: Retaliation over agricultural water channel boundary dispute following panchayat demarcation
truth.summary: On the night of 24 October 2024, near tubewell number 4 in village Chhapa, Harpreet Singh ambushed Gurpal Singh with a heavy iron rod, inflicting compound skull fracture and rib fractures before fleeing on an unlit motorcycle.

timeline.description: Gurpal Singh walked out to tubewell number 4 to inspect irrigation water flow into his wheat crop.
Harpreet Singh concealed himself behind a sugarcane thicket holding an iron rod with welded bolt head.
Harpreet Singh attacked Gurpal Singh from behind, striking his head and shoulders multiple times with the iron rod.
Harpreet Singh discarded the iron rod into a dry drainage canal and escaped on an unlit motorcycle.
Dairy farmer Balwinder Sandhu heard groans near the canal crossing, spotted Gurpal Singh bleeding, and alerted villagers.
Sub-Inspector Kuldeep Gill arrived at Civil Hospital Ludhiana, recorded initial police statement, and dispatched recovery team.
Dr. Amandeep Kaur performed emergency craniotomy on Gurpal Singh and documented depressed frontal bone fracture.

evidence.description: Heavy iron rod (length 3.2 feet) with welded bolt head recovered from drainage canal pursuant to disclosure statement under Section 23 BSA.
Medico-Legal Report (MLR No. 402/2024) from Civil Hospital certifying grievous hurt with dangerous weapon endangering life.
Certified revenue demarcation map issued by Halqa Patwari showing water channel boundary disputed between Harpreet and Gurpal.
Oral testimony of village chowkidar claiming Harpreet's cousin told him over tea that Harpreet planned the beating.
evidence.reason_inadmissible: Inadmissible hearsay evidence under Section 55 and 57 of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.

evidence.description: Affidavit of community elder claiming Harpreet Singh was attending a religious bhog ceremony 15 km away at the time of the incident.

witnesses.name: Balwinder Sandhu
hides: I owed Harpreet Singh ₹25,000 for seed fertilizer and avoided identifying him by name in my first verbal statement.

persona.tone: Blunt, rustic, cautious about village rivalries
persona.background: Lifelong resident of Village Chhapa whose cattle shed borders the irrigation canal.

witnesses.name: Sub-Inspector Kuldeep Gill
hides: The disclosure memo for weapon recovery was typed back at the police station rather than at the canal site.

persona.background: Ten years in rural policing handling land and agrarian disputes.

persona.tone: Objective, academic, unwavering on trauma assessment
persona.background: Trauma specialist with 18 years surgical experience.
